title: Simulation play patterning as a motivation tool for students
reason: Survey of pharmacy students and residents on career-choice motives and teaching preferences (percentages only), plus a description of a business game; no platform-recorded measure and no relation to learning success.

extraction.population: 3rd-5th year pharmacy students (intramural, mixed, extramural) and residents, Sechenov University
extraction.notes: English text; sample size not stated. Secondary E1.
